timeline.summary: Eimco Elecon successfully executed sale deeds for the purchase of 35,056 square meters of land in Kheda, Gujarat, for ₹45.56 crore.
Eimco Elecon issued a communication to shareholders regarding tax deduction at source on the final dividend recommended for FY26.
Elecon Engineering Company Limited (PAN: AAACE4644D) confirmed no encumbrance of its 9,58,426 shares (16.62%) in Eimco Elecon (India) Limited during FY 2025-26.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹56.8 Cr (+70.9% YoY), net profit ₹7.83 Cr (+46.4% YoY).
Eimco Elecon launched the DW-220 Hydraulic Diaphragm Wall Grab to expand its construction equipment portfolio in the domestic market.
